correctness.rationale: Weyl matrices form an orthogonal operator basis and conjugation of a rank-one window projector multiplies each Weyl coefficient by a character, so Fourier isolation makes the joint span dimension exactly the union size of nonzero ambiguity coordinates. A support pair can overlap only on translation rows 0 and plus/minus its difference, giving the universal row bound. Unequal-amplitude two-point windows make every modulation coordinate on selected rows nonzero; distinct unoriented differences attain two new rows per window, and an explicit phase handles the even antipodal row. The inspected verifier checks ambiguity support through N=20, direct projector ranks through N=10 and exhaustive support-pair row maxima through N=9; a fresh separate support-pair enumeration reproduced the combinatorial bound.

final_claim: For full cyclic Gabor orbits on C^N, the maximum complex operator-span dimension obtainable from s exactly two-sparse windows is N times min(N,1+2s); hence suitable two-sparse windows are quantum-injective exactly from s=floor(N/2) onward.
